purpose: Preserve concrete project evidence about Rock behavioral variation without falsely mapping legacy style files one-to-one onto V3 subgenre labels.

v3_variant_gate.hard_rule: Do not let broad Rock baseline stand in for a resolved subgenre when cues are available.

current_research_conclusion.evidence_gap: Existing project materials demonstrate real Rock behavior variation but do not provide a trustworthy one-to-one mapping to the current V3 candidate subgenre names.
current_research_conclusion.consequence: Build variant-specific packages only after evidence explicitly supports that variant. Do not infer Classic/Hard/Alternative/etc. from a legacy filename alone.
